dn21:1.1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā magadhesu viharati pācīnato rājagahassa ambasaṇḍo nāma brāhmaṇagāmo tassuttarato vediyake pabbate indasālaguhāyaṃ.
dn21:1.1.3: tena kho pana samayena sakkassa devānamindassa ussukkaṃ udapādi bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
dn21:1.1.5: kahaṃ nu kho bhagavā etarahi viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddhoti.
dn21:1.1.6: addasā kho sakko devānamindo bhagavantaṃ magadhesu viharantaṃ pācīnato rājagahassa ambasaṇḍo nāma brāhmaṇagāmo tassuttarato vediyake pabbate indasālaguhāyaṃ
dn21:1.1.8: ayaṃ mārisā bhagavā magadhesu viharati pācīnato rājagahassa ambasaṇḍo nāma brāhmaṇagāmo tassuttarato vediyake pabbate indasālaguhāyaṃ
dn21:1.1.9: yadi pana mārisā mayantaṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkameyyāma arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhanti.
dn21:1.1.10: evaṃ bhaddantavāti kho devā tāvatiṃsā sakkassa devānamindassa paccassosuṃ.
dn21:1.2.1: athakho sakko devānamindo pañcasikhaṃ gandhabbaputtaṃ āmantesi
dn21:1.2.2: ayaṃ tāta pañcasikha bhagavā magadhesu viharati pācīnato rājagahassa ambasaṇḍo nāma brāhmaṇagāmo tassuttarato vediyake pabbate indasālaguhāyaṃ
dn21:1.2.3: yadi hi pana tāta pañcasikha mayaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkameyyāma arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhanti.
dn21:1.2.4: evaṃ bhaddantavāti kho pañcasikho gandhabbaputto sakkassa devānamindassa paṭissutvā veḷuvapaṇḍuvīṇaṃ ādāya sakkassa devānamindassa anucariyaṃ upāgami.
dn21:1.2.5: athakho sakko devānamindo devehi tāvatiṃsehi parivuto pañcasikhena gandhabbaputtena purakkhato
dn21:1.2.6: seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya evameva kho devesu tāvatiṃsesu antarahito magadhesu pācīnato rājagahassa ambasaṇḍo nāma brāhmaṇagāmo tassuttarato vediyake pabbate paccuṭṭhāsi.
dn21:1.3.1: tena kho pana samayena vediyako pabbato atiriva obhāsajāto hoti ambasaṇḍo ca brāhmaṇagāmo yathā taṃ devānaṃ devānubhāvena.
dn21:1.3.3: ādittassu nāmajja vediyako pabbato jhāyatassu nāmajja vediyako pabbato jalatassu nāmajja vediyako kiṃ
dn21:1.3.4: su nāmajja vediyako pabbato atiriva obhāsajāto ambasaṇḍo ca brāhmaṇagāmoti.
dn21:1.4.1: athakho sakko devānamindo pañcasikhaṃ gandhabbaputtaṃ āmantesi
dn21:1.4.2: durupasaṅkamā kho tāta pañcasikha tathāgatā mādisena jhāyī jhānaratā tadanantaraṃ paṭisallīnā
dn21:1.4.3: yadi pana tvaṃ tāta pañcasikha bhagavantaṃ paṭhamaṃ pasādeyyāsi tayā tāta paṭhamaṃ pasāditaṃ pacchā mayaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkameyyāma arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhanti.
dn21:1.4.4: evaṃ bhaddantavāti kho pañcasikho gandhabbaputto sakkassa devānamindassa paṭissutvā veḷuvapaṇḍuvīṇaṃ ādāya yena indasālaguhā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā
dn21:1.4.5: ettāvatā me bhagavā neva avidūre kho vasati nāccāsanne saddañca me sossatīti
dn21:1.4.8: ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho pañcasikho gandhabbaputto veḷuvapaṇḍuvīṇaṃ ādāya assāvesi imā ca gāthāyo abhāsi buddhūpasañhitā dhammūpasañhitā saṅghūpasañhitā arahantupasañhitā kāmupasañhitā
dn21:1.6.1: evaṃ vutte bhagavā pañcasikhaṃ gandhabbaputtaṃ etadavoca
dn21:1.6.2: saṃsandati kho te pañcasikha tantissaro gītassarena gītassaro ca tantissarena
dn21:1.6.3: neva pana te pañcasikha tantissaro gītassaraṃ ativattati na gītassaro ca tantissaraṃ
dn21:1.6.4: kadā saṃyūḷhā pana te pañcasikha imā gāthā buddhūpasañhitā dhammūpasañhitā saṅghupasañhitā arahantupasañhitā kāmūpasañhitāti.
dn21:1.6.5: ekamidāhaṃ bhante samayaṃ bhagavā uruvelāyaṃ viharati najjā nerañjarāya tīre ajapālanigrodhe paṭhamābhisambuddho.
dn21:1.6.6: tena kho panāhaṃ bhante samayena bhaddā nāma suriyavacchasā timbaruno gandhabbarañño dhītā tamābhikaṅkhāmi.
dn21:1.6.7: sā kho pana bhante bhaginī parakāminī hoti
dn21:1.6.8: sikhaṇḍi nāma mātalissa saṅgāhakassa putto tamābhikaṅkhati.
dn21:1.6.9: yato kho ahaṃ bhante taṃ bhaginiṃ nālatthaṃ kenaci pariyāyena
dn21:1.6.10: athāhaṃ veḷuvapaṇḍuvīṇaṃ ādāya yena timbaruno gandhabbarañño nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃ upasaṅkamitvā veḷuvapaṇḍuvīṇaṃ assāvesiṃ imā gāthā abhāsiṃ buddhupasañhitā dhammupasañhitā saṅghupasañhitā arahantupasañhitā kāmupasañhitā
dn21:1.7.10: evaṃ vutte bhante bhaddā suriyavacchasā maṃ etadavoca
dn21:1.7.11: na kho me mārisa so bhagavā sammukhā diṭṭho apica sutoyeva me so bhagavā devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sudhammāya sabhāya upanaccantiyā
dn21:1.7.12: yato kho tvaṃ mārisa taṃ bhagavantaṃ kittesi hotu no ajja samāgamoti.
dn21:1.7.13: soyeva no bhante tassā bhaginiyā saddhiṃ samāgamo ahosi
dn21:1.8.2: paṭisammodati kho pañcasikho gandhabbaputto bhagavatā bhagavā ca pañcasikhenāti.
dn21:1.8.3: athakho sakko devānamindo pañcasikhaṃ gandhabbaputtaṃ āmantesi
dn21:1.8.4: abhivādehi me tvaṃ tāta pañcasikha bhagavantaṃ
dn21:1.8.5: sakko bhante devānamindo sāmacco saparijano bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatīti.
dn21:1.8.6: evaṃ bhaddantavāti kho pañcasikho gandhabbaputto sakkassa devānamindassa paṭissutvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādesi
dn21:1.8.7: sakko bhante devānamindo sāmacco saparijano bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatīti.
dn21:1.8.8: evaṃ sukhī hotu pañcasikha sakko devānamindo sāmacco saparijano
dn21:1.8.9: sukhakāmā hi devā manussā asurā nāgā gandhabbā ye caññe santi puthukāyāti.
dn21:1.8.10: evañca pana tathāgatā evarūpe mahesakkhe yakkhe abhivadanti.
dn21:1.8.11: abhivadito sakko devānamindo bhagavato indasālaguhaṃ pavisitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
dn21:1.8.12: devāpi tāvatiṃsā indasālaguhaṃ pavisitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
dn21:1.8.13: pañcasikhopi gandhabbaputto indasālaguhaṃ pavisitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
dn21:1.9.1: tena kho pana samayena indasālaguhā visamā santi samā samapādi sambādhā santi uruddhā samapādi andhakāro guhāyaṃ antaradhāyi āloko udapādi yathā taṃ devānaṃ devānubhāvena.
dn21:1.9.3: acchariyamidaṃ āyasmato kosiyassa abbhūtamidaṃ āyasmato kosiyassa tava bahukiccassa bahukaraṇīyassa yadidaṃ idhāgamananti.
dn21:1.9.4: cirapaṭikāhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamitukāmo apica devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ kehici kiccakaraṇīyehi byāvaṭo evāhaṃ nāsakkhiṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
dn21:1.9.5: ekamidaṃ bhante samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati salaḷāgārake.
dn21:1.9.6: athakhohaṃ bhante sāvatthiṃ agamāsiṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
dn21:1.10.1: tena kho pana bhante samayena bhagavā aññatarena samādhinā nisinno hoti. bhujagī nāma vessavaṇassa mahārājassa paricārikā bhagavantaṃ paccupaṭṭhitā hoti pañjalikā namassamānā tiṭṭhati.
dn21:1.10.4: sakko bhante devānamindo sāmacco saparijano bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatīti.
dn21:1.10.5: evaṃ vutte bhante sā bhujagī maṃ etadavoca
dn21:1.10.8: tenahi bhagini yadā bhagavā tamhā samādhimhā vuṭṭhito hoti atha mama vacanena bhagavantaṃ abhivādehi
dn21:1.10.9: sakko bhante devānamindo sāmacco saparijano bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatīti.
dn21:1.10.10: kacci me sā bhante bhaginī bhagavantaṃ abhivādesi
dn21:1.10.12: abhivādesi maṃ sā devānaminda bhaginī sarāmahaṃ tassā bhaginiyā vacanaṃ
dn21:1.10.13: apicāhaṃ āyasmato cakkanemisaddena tamhā samādhimhā vuṭṭhitoti.
dn21:1.11.1: ye te bhante devā amhehi paṭhamataraṃ tāvatiṃsakāyaṃ upapannā tesaṃ me sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
dn21:1.11.2: yadā tathāgatā loke uppajjanti arahanto sammāsambuddhā dibbā kāyā paripūrenti hāyanti asurakāyāti.
dn21:1.11.3: taṃ me idaṃ bhante sakkhidiṭṭhaṃ yato tathāgato loke uppanno arahaṃ sammāsambuddho dibbā kāyā paripūrenti hāyanti asurakāyāti.
dn21:1.11.5: idheva bhante kapilavatthusmiṃ gopikā nāma sakyadhītā ahosi buddhe pasannā dhamme pasannā saṅghe pasannā sīlesu paripūrīkārinī
dn21:1.11.6: sā itthīcittaṃ virājetvā purisacittaṃ bhāvetvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā
dn21:1.11.7: devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahabyataṃ amhākaṃ puttattaṃ ajjhupagatā
dn21:1.11.10: aññepi bhante tayo bhikkhū bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ caritvā hīnaṃ gandhabbakāyaṃ upapannā
dn21:1.11.11: te pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitā samaṅgibhūtā paricārayamānā amhākaṃ upaṭṭhānaṃ āgacchanti amhākaṃ pāricariyaṃ.
dn21:1.11.12: te amhākaṃ upaṭṭhānaṃ āgate amhākaṃ pāricariyaṃ gopako devaputto paṭicodesi
dn21:1.11.13: kutomukhā nāma tumhe mārisā tassa bhagavato dhammaṃ āyūhittha ahaṃ
dn21:1.11.14: hi nāma itthikā samānā buddhe pasannā dhamme pasannā saṅghe pasannā sīlesu paripūrīkārinī itthīcittaṃ virājetvā purisacittaṃ bhāvetvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahabyataṃ sakkassa devānamindassa puttattaṃ ajjhupagatā
dn21:1.11.17: tumhe pana mārisā bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ caritvā hīnaṃ gandhabbakāyaṃ upapannā
dn21:1.11.18: duddiṭṭharūpaṃ vata bho addasāma ye mayaṃ addasāma sahadhammike hīnaṃ gandhabbakāyaṃ upapanneti.
dn21:1.11.19: tesaṃ bhante gopakena devaputtena paṭicoditānaṃ dve devā diṭṭhe va dhamme satiṃ paṭilabhiṃsu kāyaṃ brahmapurohitaṃ. eko pana devo kāme ajjhāvasi.
dn21:1.12.66: na tattha kiṃ kaṅkhati koci sāvako
dn21:1.13.2: dīgharattaṃ visuddho kho ayaṃ sakko yaṅkiñci maṃ pañhaṃ pucchissati sabbantaṃ atthasañhitaṃyeva pucchissati no anatthasañhitaṃ
dn21:1.13.3: yañcassāhaṃ puṭṭho byākarissāmi taṃ khippameva ājānissatīti.
dn21:1.13.4: athakho bhagavā sakkaṃ devānamindaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi
dn21:2.1.1: katāvakāso sakko devānamindo bhagavatā imaṃ bhagavantaṃ paṭhamaṃ pañhaṃ apucchi
dn21:2.1.2: kiṃsaññojanā nu kho mārisa devā manussā asurā nāgā gandhabbā ye caññe santi puthukāyā te
dn21:2.1.3: averātha adaṇḍā asapattā abyāpajjhā viharemu averinoti iti ca nesaṃ hoti atha ca pana saverā sadaṇḍā sasapattā sabyāpajjhā viharachti saverinoti.
dn21:2.1.4: itthaṃ sakko devānamindo bhagavantaṃ pañhaṃ apucchi.
dn21:2.1.6: issāmacchariyasaññojanā kho devānaminda devā manussā asurā nāgā gandhabbā ye caññe santi puthukāyā te
dn21:2.1.7: averā adaṇḍā asapattā abyāpajjhā viharemu averinoti iti ca nesaṃ hoti atha ca pana saverā sadaṇḍā sasapattā sabyāpajjhā viharantā saverinoti.
dn21:2.1.8: itthaṃ bhagavā sakkassa devānamindassa pañhaṃ puṭṭho byākāsi.
dn21:2.1.9: attamano sakko devānamindo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandi anumodi
dn21:2.1.11: tiṇṇā mettha kaṅkhā vigatā kathaṃkathā bhagavato pañhāveyyākaraṇaṃ sutvāti.
dn21:2.2.1: itiha sakko devānamindo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā bhagavantaṃ uttariṃ pañhaṃ apucchi
dn21:2.2.2: issāmacchariyaṃ pana mārisa kiṃnidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiṃjātikaṃ kiṃpabhavaṃ
dn21:2.2.4: kismiṃ hi asati issāmacchariyaṃ na hotīti.
dn21:2.2.5: issāmacchariyaṃ kho devānaminda piyāppiyanidānaṃ piyāppiyasamudayaṃ piyāppiyajātikaṃ piyāppiyapabhavaṃ
dn21:2.2.8: piyāppiyaṃ pana mārisa kiṃnidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiṃjātikaṃ kiṃpabhavaṃ
dn21:2.2.11: piyāppiyaṃ kho devānaminda chandanidānaṃ chandasamudayaṃ chandajātikaṃ chandapabhavaṃ
dn21:2.2.14: chando pana mārisa kiṃnidāno kiṃsamudayo kiṃjātiko kiṃpabhavo
dn21:2.2.17: chando kho devānaminda vitakkanidāno vitakkasamudayo vitakkajātiko vitakkapabhavo
dn21:2.2.20: vitakko pana mārisa kiṃnidāno kiṃsamudayo kiṃjātiko kiṃpabhavo
dn21:2.2.23: vitakko kho devānaminda papañcasaññāsaṅkhānidāno papañcasaññāsaṅkhāsamudayo papañcasaññāsaṅkhājātiko papañcasaññāsaṅkhāpabhavo
dn21:2.3.1: kathaṃpaṭipanno pana mārisa bhikkhu papañcasaññāsaṅkhā nirodhasāruppagāminīpaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hotīti.
dn21:2.3.9: somanassaṃ cāhaṃ devānaminda duvidhena vadāmi sevitabbaṃpi asevitabbaṃpīti. iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
dn21:2.3.11: imaṃ kho me somanassaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyantīti evarūpaṃ somanassaṃ na sevitabbaṃ.
dn21:2.3.13: imaṃ kho me somanassaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantīti evarūpaṃ somanassaṃ sevitabbaṃ.
dn21:2.3.14: tattha yañce savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ yañce avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ ye avitakke avicāre paṇītatare
dn21:2.3.15: somanassaṃ cāhaṃ devānaminda duvidhena vadāmi sevitabbaṃpi asevitabbaṃpīti.

dn21:2.4.23: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
dn21:2.4.25: sevitabbaṃpi asevitabbaṃpīti. iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
dn21:2.4.26: tattha yaṃ jaññā pariyesanaṃ imaṃ kho me pariyesanaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyantīti evarūpā pariyesanā na sevitabbā.
dn21:2.4.27: tattha yaṃ jaññā pariyesanaṃ imaṃ kho me pariyesanaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantīti evarūpā pariyesanā sevitabbā.
dn21:2.4.30: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
dn21:2.4.31: evaṃpaṭipanno kho devānaminda bhikkhu pātimokkhasaṃvarāya paṭipanno hotīti.
dn21:2.5.2: pana mārisa bhikkhu indriyasaṃvarāya paṭipanno hotīti.
dn21:2.5.3: cakkhuviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ cāhaṃ devānaminda duvidhena vadāmi
dn21:2.5.5: sotaviññeyyaṃ saddaṃ cāhaṃ devānaminda duvidhena vadāmi
dn21:2.5.7: ghānaviññeyyaṃ gandhaṃ cāhaṃ devānaminda duvidhena vadāmi
dn21:2.5.13: manoviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ cāhaṃ devānaminda duvidhena vadāmi
dn21:2.5.15: evaṃ vutte sakko devānamindo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
dn21:2.5.16: imassa kho ahaṃ bhante bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi
dn21:2.5.17: yathārūpaṃ bhante cakkhuviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyantīti evarūpaṃ cakkhuviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ na sevitabbaṃ.
dn21:2.5.18: yathārūpañca kho bhante cakkhuviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantīti evarūpaṃ cakkhuviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ sevitabbaṃ.
dn21:2.5.19: yathārūpañca kho bhante sotaviññeyyaṃ saddaṃ sevato …pe…
dn21:2.5.23: manoviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyantīti evarūpo manoviññeyyo dhammo na sevitabbo.
dn21:2.5.24: yathārūpañca kho bhante manoviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantīti evarūpo manoviññeyyo dhammo sevitabbo.
dn21:2.5.25: imassa kho ahaṃ bhante bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānanto
dn21:2.5.26: tiṇṇā mettha kaṅkhā vigatā kathaṃkathā bhagavato pañhāveyyākaraṇaṃ sutvāti.
dn21:2.6.1: itiha sakko devānamindo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā bhagavantaṃ uttariṃ pañhaṃ apucchi
dn21:2.6.2: sabbe va nu kho mārisa samaṇabrāhmaṇā ekantavādā ekantasīlā ekantacchandā ekantaajjhosānāti.
dn21:2.6.3: na kho devānaminda sabbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā ekantavādā ekantasīlā ekantacchandā ekantaajjhosānāti.
dn21:2.6.4: kasmā pana mārisa na sabbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā ekantavādā ekantasīlā ekantacchandā ekantaajjhosānāti.
dn21:2.6.5: anekadhātu nānā dhātu kho devānaminda loko
dn21:2.6.6: tasmiṃ anekadhātumhi nānādhātumhi loke yaṃ yadeva sattā dhātuṃ abhinivisanti taṃ tadeva thāmasā parāmāsā abhinivissa voharanti
dn21:2.6.8: tasmā na sabbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā ekantavādā ekantasīlā ekantacchandā ekantaajjhosānāti
dn21:2.6.9: …pe… sabbe va nu kho mārisa samaṇabrāhmaṇā accantaniṭṭhā accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosānāti.
dn21:2.6.10: na kho devānaminda sabbe samaṇabrahmaṇā accantaniṭṭhā accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosānāti.
dn21:2.6.11: kasmā pana mārisa na sabbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā accantaniṭṭhā accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosānāti.
dn21:2.6.12: ye kho te devānaminda bhikkhū taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttā te accantaniṭṭhā accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosānā
dn21:2.6.13: tasmā na sabbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā accantaniṭṭhā accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosānāti.
dn21:2.6.14: itthaṃ bhagavā sakkassa devānamindassa pañhaṃ puṭṭho byākāsi.
dn21:2.6.15: attamano sakko devānamindo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandi anumodi
dn21:2.6.17: tiṇṇā mettha kaṅkhā vigatā kathaṃkathā bhagavato pañhāveyyākaraṇaṃ sutvāti.
dn21:2.6.18: itiha sakko devānamindo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
dn21:2.7.1: ejā bhante rogo ejā gaṇḍo ejā sallaṃ ejā imaṃ purisaṃ parikaḍḍhati tassa tasseva bhavassa abhinibbattiyā
dn21:2.7.3: yesāhaṃ bhante pañhānaṃ ito bahiddhā aññesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu okāsakammaṃpi nālatthaṃ te me bhagavatā byākatā
dn21:2.7.4: dīgharattānupassatā yañca pana me vicikicchākathaṃkathāsallaṃ tañca bhagavatā abbūḷhanti.
dn21:2.7.5: abhijānāsi no tvaṃ devānaminda ime pañhe aññe samaṇabrāhmaṇe pucchitoti.
dn21:2.7.6: abhijānāmahaṃ bhante ime pañhe aññe samaṇabrāhmaṇe pucchitoti.
dn21:2.7.7: yathākathaṃ pana te devānaminda byākariṃsu sace te agaru bhāsassūti.
dn21:2.7.8: na kho me bhante garu yatthassa bhagavā nisinno bhagavantarūpo cāti.
dn21:2.7.10: yesāhaṃ bhante maññāmi samaṇabrāhmaṇā āraññakā pantasenāsanāti tyāhaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ime pañhe pucchāmi te mayā puṭṭhā na sampāyanti asampāyantā mamaṃyeva paṭipucchanti
dn21:2.7.15: kiṃ panāyasmā devānaminda kammaṃ katvā imaṃ ṭhānaṃ pattoti
dn21:2.7.18: sakko ca no devānamindo diṭṭho yañca no apucchimhā tañca no byākāsīti
dn21:2.7.19: te aññadatthuṃ mamaṃyeva sāvakā sampajjanti na cāhaṃ tesaṃ
dn21:2.7.20: ahaṃ kho pana bhante bhagavato sāvako sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyanoti.
dn21:2.7.22: abhijānāsi no tvaṃ devānaminda ito pubbe evarūpaṃ vedapaṭilābhaṃ somanassapaṭilābhanti.
dn21:2.7.23: abhijānāmahaṃ bhante ito pubbe evarūpaṃ vedapaṭilābhaṃ somanassapaṭilābhanti.
dn21:2.7.24: yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ devānaminda abhijānāsi ito pubbe evarūpaṃ vedapaṭilābhaṃ somanassapaṭilābhanti.
dn21:2.7.26: tasmiṃ kho pana bhante saṅgāme devā jiniṃsu asurā va parājayiṃsu.
dn21:2.7.27: tassa mayhaṃ bhante taṃ saṅgāmaṃ abhivijinitvā abhivijitasaṅgāmassa etadahosi
dn21:2.7.28: yā cevadāni dibbā ojā yā ca asurā ojā ubhayamettha devā paribhuñjissantīti
dn21:2.7.29: so kho pana me bhante vedapaṭilābho somanassapaṭilābho sadaṇḍāvacaro sasatthāvacaro na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati
dn21:2.7.30: yo kho pana me ayaṃ bhante bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā vedapaṭilābho somanassapaṭilābho so adaṇḍāvacaro asatthāvacaro ekantanibbibāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattatīti.
dn21:2.8.1: kathaṃ pana tvaṃ devānaminda atthavasaṃ sampassamāno evarūpaṃ vedapaṭilābhaṃ somanassapaṭilābhaṃ pavedesīti.
dn21:2.8.2: cha kho ahaṃ bhante atthavase sampassamāno evarūpaṃ vedapaṭilābhaṃ somanassapaṭilābhaṃ pavedemi.
dn21:2.8.7: imaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante paṭhamaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno evarūpaṃ vedapaṭilābhaṃ somanassapaṭilābhaṃ pavedemi.
dn21:2.8.12: imaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante dutiyaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno evarūpaṃ vedapaṭilābhaṃ somanassapaṭilābhaṃ pavedemi.
dn21:2.8.17: imaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante tatiyaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno evarūpaṃ vedapaṭilābhaṃ somanassapaṭilābhaṃ pavedemi.
dn21:2.8.22: imaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante catutthaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno evarūpaṃ vedapaṭilābhaṃ somanassapaṭilābhaṃ pavedemi.
dn21:2.8.27: imaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante pañcamaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno evarūpaṃ vedapaṭilābhaṃ somanassapaṭilābhaṃ pavedemi.
dn21:2.8.32: imaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante chaṭṭhaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno evarūpaṃ vedapaṭilābhaṃ somanassapaṭilābhaṃ pavedemi.
dn21:2.8.33: ime kho ahaṃ bhante cha atthavase sampassamāno evarūpaṃ vedapaṭilābhaṃ somanassapaṭilābhaṃ pavedemi.
dn21:2.10.1: athakho sakko devānamindo pañcasikhaṃ gandhabbaputtaṃ āmantesi
dn21:2.10.2: bahūpakāro kho mesi tvaṃ tāta pañcasikha yaṃ tvaṃ bhagavantaṃ paṭhamaṃ pasādesi
dn21:2.10.3: tayā tāta paṭhamaṃ pasāditaṃ pacchā mayaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamimhā arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ
dn21:2.10.4: pettike ṭhāne ṭhapayissāmi gandhabbarājā bhavissasi bhaddañca te suriyavacchasaṃ dammi sā hi te abhipatthitāti.
dn21:2.10.5: athakho sakko devānamindo pāṇinā paṭhaviṃ parāmasitvā tikkhattuṃ udānaṃ udānesi
dn21:2.10.9: imasmiñca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne sakkassa devānamindassa virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
dn21:2.10.12: iti ye sakkena devānamindena ajjhiṭṭhapañhā puṭṭhā te bhagavatā byākatā.
